title: Singular subscription discounts removed
description: Basil removes singular coupon and promotion_code parameters in favor of discounts. Scoped to migration from SDK >=17.0.0 <18.0.0 to 18.0.0.
oldBehavior: Subscription create/update accepted singular discount parameters.
migrationInstructions: Build discounts entries and review interactions with existing discounts.

evidenceSources.summary: Basil removes singular coupon and promotion_code parameters in favor of discounts.
The tagged v18 changelog pins Basil and identifies the removed SDK helpers, subscription parameters and period fields.
